models sometimes generate full forms\\nENTITY_TYPE_ALIASES = {\\n    'PERSON': 'PER',\\n    'PEOPLE': 'PER',\\n    'ORGANIZATION': 'ORG',\\n    'ORGANISATION': 'ORG',\\n    'LOCATION': 'LOC',\\n    'NUMBER': 'NUM',\\n    'NUMERICAL': 'NUM',\\n    'MISCELLANEOUS': 'MISC',\\n}\\n\\n\\ndef normalize_entity_type(raw_type):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Strip whitespace, uppercase, and apply alias mapping.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    t = raw_type.strip().upper()\\n    return ENTITY_TYPE_ALIASES.get(t, t)\\n\\n\\n\\ndef _levenshtein(s1, s2):\\n    if len(s1) < len(s2):\\n        return _levenshtein(s2, s1)\\n    if len(s2) == 0:\\n        return len(s1)\\n    prev_row = range(len(s2) + 1)\\n    for i, c1 in enumerate(s1):\\n        curr_row = [i + 1]\\n        for j, c2 in enumerate(s2):\\n            insertions = prev_row[j + 1] + 1\\n            deletions = curr_row[j] + 1\\n            substitutions = prev_row[j] + (c1 != c2)\\n            curr_row.append(min(insertions, deletions, substitutions))\\n        prev_row = curr_row\\n    return prev_row[-1]\\n\\n\\ndef load_constraints(path: str) -> dict:\\n    with open(path) as f:\\n        return json.load(f)\\n\\n\\ndef build_relation_name_to_id(rel_types: dict) -> dict:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Map relation name -> relation ID for matching model output.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    name_to_id = {}\\n    for rid, rname in rel_types.items():\\n        name_to_id[rname.lower().strip()] = rid\\n        name_to_id[rid.lower()] = rid\\n    return name_to_id\\n\\n\\ndef normalize_relation(rel_name, rel_types, name_to_id):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Fuzzy-match a model-output relation name to the nearest ontology relation.\\n\\n    Match conditions (any one suffices):\\n    1. Exact match via name_to_id (case-insensitive)\\n    2. Token overlap > 80%\\n    3. Levenshtein distance <= 2 on the relation name\\n\\n    Returns: (matched_pid, matched_name, is_fuzzy_match) or (None, None, False)\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    rel_key = name_to_id.get(rel_name.lower().strip())\\n    if rel_key:\\n        return rel_key, rel_types.get(rel_key, rel_name), False\\n\\n    rel_tokens = set(rel_name.strip().lower().split())\\n    best_pid, best_name = None, None\\n    best_overlap = 0.0\\n    for rid, rname in rel_types.items():\\n        rname_tokens = set(rname.lower().split())\\n        if rel_tokens and rname_tokens:\\n            overlap = len(rel_tokens & rname_tokens)\\n            union = len(rel_tokens | rname_tokens)\\n            ratio = overlap / union\\n            if ratio > 0.8 and ratio > best_overlap:\\n                best_overlap = ratio\\n                best_pid, best_name = rid, rname\\n    if best_pid:\\n        return best_pid, best_name, True\\n\\n    for rid, rname in rel_types.items():\\n        if _levenshtein(rel_name.strip().lower(), rname.lower()) <= 2:\\n            return rid, rname, True\\n\\n    return None, None, False\\n\\n\\ndef check_document(parsed, constraints, rel_types, name_to_id):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Check violations for one document parsed output.\\n\\n    v2: ET violations counted per unique entity (text+type dedup).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    entities = parsed.get(\\\"entities\\\", [])\\n    relations = parsed.get(\\\"relations\\\", [])\\n\\n    violations = {\\n        \\\"entity_type\\\": [],\\n        \\\"relation_vocabulary\\\": [],\\n        \\\"domain_range\\\": [],\\n        \\\"cross_field_consistency\\\": [],\\n    }\\n    fuzzy_matches = 0\\n\\n    seen_entities = {}\\n    for ent in entities:\\n        text = ent.get(\\\"text\\\", \\\"?\\\")\\n        etype = ent.get(\\\"type\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n        norm = normalize_entity_type(etype)\\n        key = (text.lower().strip(), norm)\\n        if key not in seen_entities:\\n            seen_entities[key] = {\\\"entity\\\": text, \\\"invalid_type\\\": etype}\\n\\n    for rel in relations:\\n        head = rel.get(\\\"head\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n        tail = rel.get(\\\"tail\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n        h_type = rel.get(\\\"head_type\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n        t_type = rel.get(\\\"tail_type\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n        if head and h_type:\\n            norm_h = normalize_entity_type(h_type)\\n            key = (head.lower().strip(), norm_h)\\n            if key not in seen_entities:\\n                seen_entities[key] = {\\\"entity\\\": head, \\\"invalid_type\\\": h_type}\\n        if tail and t_type:\\n            norm_t = normalize_entity_type(t_type)\\n            key = (tail.lower().strip(), norm_t)\\n            if key not in seen_entities:\\n                seen_entities[key] = {\\\"entity\\\": tail, \\\"invalid_type\\\": t_type}\\n\\n    for (_, norm_type), info in seen_entities.items():\\n        if norm_type not in VALID_ENTITY_TYPES:\\n            violations[\\\"entity_type\\\"].append(info)\\n\\n    entity_type_assignments = defaultdict(set)\\n\\n    for rel in relations:\\n        head = rel.get(\\\"head\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n        tail = rel.get(\\\"tail\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n        h_type = rel.get(\\\"head_type\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n        t_type = rel.get(\\\"tail_type\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n        rel_type = rel.get(\\\"type\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n\\n        if head and h_type:\\n            entity_type_assignments[head.lower()].add(normalize_entity_type(h_type))\\n        if tail and t_type:\\n            entity_type_assignments[tail.lower()].add(normalize_entity_type(t_type))\\n\\n        matched_pid, matched_name, is_fuzzy = normalize_relation(rel_type, rel_types, name_to_id)\\n\\n        if matched_pid is None:\\n            violations[\\\"relation_vocabulary\\\"].append({\\n                \\\"head\\\": head,\\n                \\\"tail\\\": tail,\\n                \\\"relation\\\": rel_type,\\n                \\\"reason\\\": \\\"unknown_relation_type\\\",\\n            })\\n            continue\\n\\n        if is_fuzzy:\\n            fuzzy_matches += 1\\n\\n        if matched_pid in constraints.get(\\\"relation_constraints\\\", {}):\\n            valid_pairs = constraints[\\\"relation_constraints\\\"][matched_pid][\\\"valid_pairs\\\"]\\n            pair = [normalize_entity_type(h_type), normalize_entity_type(t_type)]\\n            if pair not in valid_pairs:\\n                violations[\\\"domain_range\\\"].append({\\n                    \\\"head\\\": head,\\n                    \\\"tail\\\": tail,\\n                    \\\"relation\\\": rel_type,\\n                    \\\"relation_id\\\": matched_pid,\\n                    \\\"matched_name\\\": matched_name,\\n                    \\\"head_type\\\": h_type,\\n                    \\\"tail_type\\\": t_type,\\n                })\\n\\n    for entity_name, types in entity_type_assignments.items():\\n        if len(types) > 1:\\n            violations[\\\"cross_field_consistency\\\"].append({\\n                \\\"entity\\\": entity_name,\\n                \\\"conflicting_types\\\": sorted(types),\\n            })\\n\\n    return violations, fuzzy_matches\\n\\n\\ndef main():\\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\\\"Check ontology constraint violations (DocRED)\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--input_path\\\", type=str, default=\\\"outputs/raw_outputs_docred.jsonl\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--constraints_path\\\", type=str, default=\\\"data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--output_path\\\", type=str, default=\\\"outputs/violation_report_docred.json\\\")\\n    args = parser.parse_args()\\n\\n    constraints = load_constraints(args.constraints_path)\\n    rel_types = constraints.get(\\\"relation_types\\\", {})\\n    name_to_id = build_relation_name_to_id(rel_types)\\n\\n    records = []\\n    with open(args.input_path) as f:\\n        for line in f:\\n            line = line.strip()\\n            if line:\\n                records.append(json.loads(line))\\n\\n\", \"stderr\": \"\", \"return_code\": 0}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {\"elapsed_seconds\": 0.44}}"}

cat > /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/scripts/eval_d064.py << 'PYEOF'
"""Unified evaluation for d064 DocRED beam search experiments.
Usage: python scripts/eval_d064.py --input_path <output.jsonl> [--label <name>]
Computes: ET%, RV%, DR%, CF%, Entity F1, Relation F1, Parse Fail%
"""
import json
import argparse
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ONTOLOGY_FILE = "/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json"

ENTITY_TYPE_ALIASES = {
    'PERSON': 'PER', 'PEOPLE': 'PER',
    'ORGANIZATION': 'ORG', 'ORGANISATION': 'ORG',
    'LOCATION': 'LOC', 'NUMBER': 'NUM', 'NUMERICAL': 'NUM',
    'MISCELLANEOUS': 'MISC',
}

def normalize_etype(raw):
    t = raw.strip().upper()
    return ENTITY_TYPE_ALIASES.get(t, t)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--input_path", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--label", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--output_json", default="")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    with open(ONTOLOGY_FILE) as f:
        ontology = json.load(f)

    VALID_ENTITY_TYPES = set(ontology["entity_types"])
    RELATION_TYPES = ontology["relation_types"]
    RELATION_CONSTRAINTS = ontology["relation_constraints"]

    name_to_pcode = {}
    for pcode, name in RELATION_TYPES.items():
        name_to_pcode[name.lower().strip()] = pcode
        name_to_pcode[name.strip()] = pcode

    VALID_RELATION_NAMES = set(name.lower().strip() for name in RELATION_TYPES.values())

    valid_pairs_by_pcode = {}
    for pcode, constraint in RELATION_CONSTRAINTS.items():
        valid_pairs_by_pcode[pcode] = set(tuple(p) for p in constraint["valid_pairs"])

    total_samples = 0
    parse_failures = 0
    total_entities_pred = 0
    total_relations_pred = 0
    et_violations = 0
    rv_violations = 0
    dr_violations = 0
    cf_violations = 0

    entity_tp = entity_fp = entity_fn = 0
    relation_tp = relation_fp = relation_fn = 0

    with open(args.input_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            total_samples += 1
            doc = json.loads(line)
            parsed = doc.get("parsed_output")
            gold_entities = doc.get("gold_entities", [])
            gold_relations = doc.get("gold_relations", [])

            if parsed is None or parsed == {}:
                parse_failures += 1
                entity_fn += len(set((e["text"], e["type"]) for e in gold_entities))
                relation_fn += len(set((r["head"], r["tail"], r["type"]) for r in gold_relations))
                continue

            pred_entities = parsed.get("entities", [])
            pred_relations = parsed.get("relations", [])
            total_entities_pred += len(pred_entities)
            total_relations_pred += len(pred_relations)

            # ET violations
            for ent in pred_entities:
                if normalize_etype(ent.get("type", "")) not in VALID_ENTITY_TYPES:
                    et_violations += 1

            # Relation violations + CF
            entity_type_map = defaultdict(set)
            for rel in pred_relations:
                rel_name = rel.get("type", "").lower().strip()
                head_type = rel.get("head_type", "")
                tail_type = rel.get("tail_type", "")

                if rel.get("head") and head_type:
                    entity_type_map[rel["head"].lower()].add(normalize_etype(head_type))
                if rel.get("tail") and tail_type:
                    entity_type_map[rel["tail"].lower()].add(normalize_etype(tail_type))

                if rel_name not in VALID_RELATION_NAMES:
                    rv_violations += 1
                    continue

                pcode = name_to_pcode.get(rel_name)
                if pcode and pcode in valid_pairs_by_pcode:
                    pair = (normalize_etype(head_type), normalize_etype(tail_type))
                    if pair not in valid_pairs_by_pcode[pcode]:
                        dr_violations += 1

            for entity_name, types in entity_type_map.items():
                if len(types) > 1:
                    cf_violations += 1

            # Entity F1
            gold_ent_set = set((e["text"], e["type"]) for e in gold_entities)
            pred_ent_set = set((e["text"], e["type"]) for e in pred_entities)
            entity_tp += len(gold_ent_set & pred_ent_set)
            entity_fp += len(pred_ent_set - gold_ent_set)
            entity_fn += len(gold_ent_set - pred_ent_set)

            # Relation F1
            gold_rel_set = set()
            for r in gold_relations:
                rtype_pcode = r["type"]
                rtype_name = RELATION_TYPES.get(rtype_pcode, rtype_pcode).lower().strip()
                gold_rel_set.add((r["head"], r["tail"], rtype_name))

            pred_rel_set = set()
            for r in pred_relations:
                rtype_name = r.get("type", "").lower().strip()
                pred_rel_set.add((r["head"], r["tail"], rtype_name))

            relation_tp += len(gold_rel_set & pred_rel_set)
            relation_fp += len(pred_rel_set - gold_rel_set)
            relation_fn += len(gold_rel_set - pred_rel_set)

    def prf(tp, fp, fn):
        p = tp / (tp + fp) * 100 if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0.0
        r = tp / (tp + fn) * 100 if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0.0
        f1 = 2 * p * r / (p + r) if (p + r) > 0 else 0.0
        return p, r, f1

    e_p, e_r, e_f1 = prf(entity_tp, entity_fp, entity_fn)
    r_p, r_r, r_f1 = prf(relation_tp, relation_fp, relation_fn)

    pf_pct = parse_failures / total_samples * 100 if total_samples else 0
    et_pct = et_violations / total_entities_pred * 100 if total_entities_pred else 0
    rv_pct = rv_violations / total_relations_pred * 100 if total_relations_pred else 0
    dr_pct = dr_violations / total_relations_pred * 100 if total_relations_pred else 0
    cf_pct = cf_violations / total_entities_pred * 100 if total_entities_pred else 0

    label = args.label or Path(args.input_path).stem
    results = {
        "label": label,
        "total_samples": total_samples,
        "parse_failures": parse_failures, "parse_fail_pct": round(pf_pct, 2),
        "total_entities_pred": total_entities_pred,
        "total_relations_pred": total_relations_pred,
        "ET_pct": round(et_pct, 2), "RV_pct": round(rv_pct, 2),
        "DR_pct": round(dr_pct, 2), "CF_pct": round(cf_pct, 2),
        "E_P": round(e_p, 2), "E_R": round(e_r, 2), "E_F1": round(e_f1, 2),
        "R_P": round(r_p, 2), "R_R": round(r_r, 2), "R_F1": round(r_f1, 2),
        "et_violations": et_violations, "rv_violations": rv_violations,
        "dr_violations": dr_violations, "cf_violations": cf_violations,
    }

    print(f"\n=== {label} ===")
    print(f"Samples: {total_samples}, Parse Fail: {parse_failures} ({pf_pct:.1f}%)")
    print(f"Entities pred: {total_entities_pred}, Relations pred: {total_relations_pred}")
    print(f"ET%={et_pct:.2f}  RV%={rv_pct:.2f}  DR%={dr_pct:.2f}  CF%={cf_pct:.2f}")
    print(f"E-F1={e_f1:.2f} (P={e_p:.2f} R={e_r:.2f})")
    print(f"R-F1={r_f1:.2f} (P={r_p:.2f} R={r_r:.2f})")

    if args.output_json:
        with open(args.output_json, "w") as f:
            json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
        print(f"Saved to {args.output_json}")

    return results

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
